deliverables: WP1 - Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure
Open-source on-chain infrastructure covering smart contract engineering, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, and wallet/API ecosystem layer
Visa card issuance linked directly to on-chain balances
Milestone-based disbursement controls through TRSC and PSSC
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v for later project-specific disbursement; vendor is Wirex via Intersect administration.
request.what: Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex, including open-source payments infrastructure, on-chain settlement, card infrastructure, banking/stablecoin rails, wallet/API ecosystem layer, and oversight through Intersect treasury management smart contracts.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,961,538 ADA, consisting of 3,846,153 ADA for WP1 and 115,385 ADA for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Wirex is claimed to have 7 million users, more than 1.5 million cards issued, more than $20 billion in transaction volume, and Visa Principal Member experience.

The proposed system is described as full-stack, open-source payments infrastructure enabling on-chain settlement through smart contracts while connecting Cardano to banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces.
The proposal claims Visa card integration will allow users to spend digital assets globally at millions of merchants from on-chain balances.
The proposer claims the work will unlock new transaction volume, user growth, institutional participation, and real-world economic activity on-chain for Cardano.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides related voting and audit references.
The proposer states the requested withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
The proposal states audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties.

The proposal states Intersect will administer funds using Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses and multi-party authorization thresholds involving Intersect admins, Intersect leadership, and six oversight entities.
The proposal states Wirex has not received ADA from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

summary: The anchor asks for 3,961,538 ADA to fund Wirex payments infrastructure through Intersect-managed treasury contracts, with strong governance-process references but limited anchor-level detail on concrete milestones, acceptance criteria, timelines, and verification of adoption claims.
